plain.li: Saw to {OTHER_nameDef} today, who isn't one of ours and walked a long way to be seen. I hope it was worth the walk.
Treated a stranger, {OTHER_nameDef}. Same body as anyone's, same complaints.
{OTHER_nameDef} came for the hospital and found me. I did what I'd do for any of ours.
[lowtech] {OTHER_nameDef} had heard of our sickroom three valleys away. I don't know whether to be proud or worried.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} held my hand a moment longer than needed when I'd finished. People out there don't get much care.

cheerful.li: A patient from outside the walls! {OTHER_nameDef} says they talk about us on the road. Good things, apparently.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} walked days to get here. It makes me think about everyone who couldn't.

cold.li: Treated an outside patient, {OTHER_nameDef}. Good for our standing with their people.

plain.li: [known] A trader told me they speak well of our hospital on the road. I went and swept it out, for some reason.
[known] People out there know about our sickroom now. Every bed in it has a story, and most of them end well.
[renowned] They say the sick come a long way to us now. I counted the beds again tonight. We'll need more.
[renowned] Our hospital has a name across the region. I remember when it was one cot and a bucket.

warm.li: [known] I think of the ones who lay in those beds and walked out again. They're the ones spreading the word.

blunt.li: The hospital has a name now. Good. More work.

gloomy.li: A good name means more patients, and more of the ones nobody else could help.

cold.li: Our hospital's reputation is an asset. I intend to keep it.

plain.li: [opt0] A stranger came with a {TALE} and asked for me by name. I saw to {X_objective}. Word gets about, it seems.
[opt0,camp] One of the camp people came up with a {TALE}. Treated {X_objective} by their fire, with an audience.
[opt1] Gave {X_nameDef} a dose for the road and what advice I could. I'd have liked to do more.
[opt2] Sent {X_nameDef} on with a few words and no medicine. We need what we have. I keep telling myself that.

warm.li: [opt0] {X_nameDef} thanked me three times on the way out. Once would have been plenty.

cheerful.li: [opt0] Somebody walked days to see me! I tried to be worth it.

gloomy.li: [opt2] {X_nameDef} came all this way and got a few words from me. That will stay with me.

cold.li: [opt0] Treated an outsider. Their people will remember it; that is worth one dose.

plain.li: [hunger] Eating properly again. My body can't believe it, and keeps asking for more, then falling asleep.
[hunger] The hungry days are over. My legs haven't heard yet; I sit down after every flight of steps.
[exposure] Warm again, and I can feel my fingers. The rest of me is tired in a way I've never been tired before.
[exposure] They brought me in just in time, they say. I don't remember most of it. I remember the blanket.
[exposure,summer] The heat nearly had me. Now I drink a cup of water every hour whether I want it or not.

gloomy.li: [hunger] We went hungry, and it took something out of me that a few good meals won't put back straight away.
